title: Peruvian Sashimi Tacos
description: A fusion dish that combines the freshness of sashimi with the flavors of Peruvian cuisine, all wrapped up in a crispy taco.

ingredients.name: Corn Tortillas
ingredients.notes: Look for corn tortillas that are gluten-free

ingredients.name: Aji Amarillo Pepper Sauce
ingredients.notes: This Peruvian hot sauce adds a nice kick

ingredients.name: Red Onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the red onion for a nice crunch

ingredients.name: Cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chopped cilantro adds a fresh flavor

ingredients.name: Lime Juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lime juice is a must

ingredients.name: Salt and Pepper
ingredients.notes: Season with salt and pepper to taste

instructions: Slice the sushi-grade tuna into thin pieces.
Cut the corn tortillas into quarters.
Drizzle the Aji Amarillo pepper sauce over the tuna.
Top the tuna with a sprinkle of cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of tuna onto a tortilla quarter.
Top with a sprinkle of red onion and a squeeze of lime juice.
